## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/target">Target</a> specific streamer interface.</p>


<p>This is used so that targets can implement support for target specific assembly directives.</p>


<p>If target foo wants to use this, it should implement 3 classes:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>FooTargetStreamer : public <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mctargetstreamer">MCTargetStreamer</a></li>
<li>FooTargetAsmStreamer : public FooTargetStreamer</li>
<li>FooTargetELFStreamer : public FooTargetStreamer</li>
</ul>

<p>FooTargetStreamer should have a pure virtual method for each directive. For example, for a ".bar symbol_name" directive, it should have virtual emitBar(const MCSymbol &amp;Symbol) = 0;</p>


<p>The FooTargetAsmStreamer and FooTargetELFStreamer classes implement the method. The assembly streamer just prints ".bar symbol_name". The object streamer does whatever is needed to implement .bar in the object file.</p>


<p>In the assembly printer and parser the target streamer can be used by calling getTargetStreamer and casting it to FooTargetStreamer:</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mctargetstreamer">MCTargetStreamer</a> &amp;TS = OutStreamer.getTargetStreamer(); FooTargetStreamer &amp;ATS = static_cast&lt;FooTargetStreamer &amp;&gt;(TS);</p>


<p>The base classes FooTargetAsmStreamer and FooTargetELFStreamer should <em>never</em> be treated differently. Callers should always talk to a FooTargetStreamer.</p>


<p>Definition at line 94 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mc/mcstreamer-h">MCStreamer.h</a>.</p>
